purpose: A presentation/viability grammar derived from the original monochrome specimen-grid reference. It rejects broken or compositionally unusable phenotypes; it is not a beauty score.
notes: The gate should be source-agnostic and should not reward a specific morphology.
OPEN evolution must preserve rejected stepping stones in the archive even when the gallery hides them.
Human preference and YouTube attention are never part of this viability gate.
Foreground is measured above an adaptive threshold relative to the near-black background, because the target reference aesthetic uses deliberately faint marks.
